collection.title: Skoda Superb Saloon 2004 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Skoda Superb Saloon 2004 to 2008 will fit, this model requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
